name: Zoom Webinars
description: Zoom Webinars supports large hosted broadcasts with registration, panelists, engagement, Q&A, polls, livestreaming, recordings, and reporting.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Server-to-Server OAuth app and one fixed licensed host, then inspect a bounded content-free page of webinar lifecycle metadata.

capabilities.label: Read webinar lifecycle
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded content-free schedule and type metadata for one configured webinar host.

approvalRequired.label: List webinar lifecycle
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded page of content-free webinar schedule and type metadata for one configured host.

blocked.label: Identity and content
blocked.description: Topics, agendas, webinar UUIDs and IDs, host identity, join/start URLs, passwords, invite links, tracking data, custom questions, and raw records are not returned.

blocked.label: People and engagement
blocked.description: Registrants, panelists, participants, absentees, attendance, contacts, Q&A, polls, surveys, chat, feedback, reactions, and engagement analytics are not exposed.

blocked.label: Media and AI
blocked.description: Recordings, transcripts, summaries, AI Companion conversations, archives, livestreams, branding assets, local tokens, and real-time media are not exposed.

blocked.label: Changes and raw API
blocked.description: Creation, update, deletion, status changes, registration, invitations, branding, livestreaming, and arbitrary paths, hosts, filters, cursors, origins, or tokens are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every host-bound webinar lifecycle read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected lifecycle reads run without Relay per-action approval while fixed origins, host binding, endpoint, bound, redaction, audit, scope, licensing, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one approval-aware fixed-host Zoom Webinars lifecycle tool and obtains short-lived account tokens server-side.
Railway mounts one approval-aware fixed-host Zoom Webinars lifecycle tool and obtains short-lived account tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer administrator must activate a Server-to-Server OAuth app with only webinar:read:list_webinars:admin, provide encrypted credentials and one licensed host ID, and enable a webinar plan.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure the dedicated customer app, fixed host and Railway credentials, verify licensing and scope, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous reads, verify renewal/revocation, deploy through the integration lane, and run live acceptance.

evidence.supports: Zoom documents GET /v2/users/{userId}/webinars, webinar plan requirements, bounded page_size, and response fields including private topics, agendas, IDs and join URLs that Relay excludes.
Zoom maps List webinars to webinar:read:list_webinars:admin and separates registrant, participant, panelist, poll, survey, branding, streaming, token, and mutation scopes.
Zoom added include_events_webinar and is_events_webinar request fields in April 2026; Relay fixes inclusion off and does not expose caller-selected filtering.
